origin: local release build served in browser inside an iframe whose CSS viewport width was explicitly measured with window.innerWidth
method: Each editorial route was loaded at each declared CSS width; browser DOM measurements checked innerWidth, document/body scroll width, H1 clipping, hero column count, image completion and meaningful image alt text.
nested_table_overflow: Contained within the designated .table-scroll region; no document-level overflow.
limitations: The iframe used a real measured CSS viewport; it is not a browser zoom test.
No 125%, 150%, or 200% browser zoom run was made.
The contact sheet and one full-page article screenshot were visually reviewed; this does not claim pixel-by-pixel human inspection of every page.
